ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 823.3. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 35 · daily cycle day 52).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 823.3. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 823.3 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 52 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 52 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 35 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 35 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 823.3 下方。并非投资性买入；在采信之前，请等待周线周期真正转向上行（或出现新的投资者周期低点予以确认）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量开始上翘；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 35 周 · 日线周期第 52 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：逆势反弹。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE signal triggered 6 trading days ago (~2026-06-04), switching from DOWNTREND. Signal strength: mild (score -35/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 逆势反弹信号于 6 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-04），自下跌趋势切换而来。 信号强度：温和（评分 -35/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱高风险反弹（+30）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Parker-Hannifin Corporation, originally Parker Appliance Company, is an American multinational industrial manufacturing company specializing in motion and control technologies. Its corporate headquarters are in Mayfield Heights, Ohio, in Greater Cleveland.
profile.description_zh: 派克汉尼汾公司（Parker-Hannifin Corporation），前身为派克器具公司（Parker Appliance Company），是一家美国跨国工业制造企业，专精于运动与控制技术，公司总部位于俄亥俄州大克利夫兰地区的梅菲尔德海茨。
